transfer_design.topology: DEV shifted barrier rows 6/10 and gap [2,5,11,14] vs TRAIN rows 7/9 and gap [3,4,12,13]

rule: After observed gate closure, retain cached route until still-closed material is <= 1/2/4/8/12 cached moves away; recheck material every step. No future mode or forecast is passed to guard policy.
warnings: Guard threshold selection uses TRAIN only and an observable synthetic gate occupancy/route distance; no new neural checkpoint
Future-conditioned non-ABI cue arms run as historical comparators but are excluded from deployable-arm summary
Current V8 runner does not expose RSS or per-inference percentiles; Node CLI records process RSS/resourceUsage when independently run
Receipt fingerprints in synthetic source are FNV diagnostics, not SHA-256 and not evidence of native ABI
Every DEVELOPMENT episode is independently replayed by the source simulator; cross-language Python/native replay not established
